notes.title: Bendy: Lone Wolf
notes.content:
Boris and the Dark Survival will be transforming into Bendy: Lone Wolf, along with a rebrand will have a large overhaul of the entire game. This means that Bendy: Lone Wolf will be a completely new game on steam that will build on the foundation of Boris and the Dark Survival but expand it into a full featured experience. Upon release, Boris and the Dark Survival will be discontinued. However, anybody who owns Boris and the Dark Survival will receive a free copy of Bendy: Lone Wolf. We hope you will join Boris as his dark survival finally unfolds to a conclusion.

What's New?

 New Features
 New Combat
 New Conclusion
 New Enemies
 New Bosses
 New Weapons
 New Achievements
 New Mini Games
 New Hazards
 Same Boris

Bendy: Lone Wolf will release in 2025!
